page.title: Join with an in-person invite
page.intro: Someone you know invites you in person: scan the code on their screen.
page.friendIntro: Scan the code on their screen. You become friends once you've both signed.

scan.hint: Point your camera at the code on their screen.
scan.noCamera: We couldn't use your camera. Allow camera access and try again.
scan.bad: That code didn't work. Ask them to show a fresh one.

sas.title: Your code
sas.body: Show this number to the person inviting you. They confirm that it matches theirs.
sas.bodyFriend: Show this number to them. They confirm that it matches theirs.

ended.cancelled: The invite was cancelled. If the numbers didn't match, scan a fresh code.
ended.expired: The invite expired. Ask for a fresh code.

form.title: Create your account
form.name: Display name (optional)
form.tos: I accept the terms of service (version {version}).
form.readTerms: Read the terms of service (opens in a new tab)
form.age: I am at least {age} years old.

done.title: Welcome!
done.invitedBy: You were invited by {handle}, and you're now connected.

errors.handle_invalid: Usernames are 3 to 20 letters, digits or underscores, and some are reserved.
errors.handle_taken: That username is taken. Try another one.
errors.display_name_invalid: That display name can't be used.
errors.tos_required: Accept the terms of service to continue.

sound.title: Play the handshake sound
sound.body: Hold your phone close to theirs and play the sound.
sound.bodyQuiet: Hold your phone close to theirs and play the near-silent tone.
sound.playing: Playing the sound… keep your phone close to theirs.
sound.retryVolume: They couldn't hear it. Turn your volume up and play it again.
sound.retryJingle: They couldn't hear the quiet tone. Ask them to switch the jingle on, then play it again.
sound.noAttempts: No tries left. Ask for a new code.
sound.failed: The sound couldn't be played on this device. Turn the volume up and try again.
sound.blocked: Your browser didn't let the sound start. Check your phone isn't muted or on silent, turn the volume up, then tap Play again.

dual.title: Scan their second code
dual.hint: Point your camera at the second code on their screen.
dual.retry: That code didn't work. Scan it again.

ceremony.title: Sign your invite
ceremony.body: Sign with your new passkey to finish.
ceremony.bodyTip: Your passkey signs these records. Your account is created once you and the person who invited you have both signed.
ceremony.awaiting: Waiting for the person who invited you to sign…

upgrade.title: Sign the friendship record
upgrade.doneAcquaintances: Done! You're now acquaintances. Meet again with sound to become friends.

recovery.done: Done. Continue on the recovery page.
